description: The Dome of the Rock (691-692) on the upper platform of the Temple Mount esplanade: the tiled octagon under its gilded dome, the Dome of the Chain, the small domed shrines and the free-standing arcades at the heads of the platform's stairs. The Western Wall and its plaza, at the lower ground level, are the separate plaza-level model.
